attributes.blockerTitle: A Spec cannot hold a file as its example
attributes.detail:
The 22 file-def concepts (`PNG File`, `WAV File`, `GTS File`…) are shown properly by an actual file, not by a card. `Spec.linkedExamples` is `linksToMany(CardDef)` and `containedExamples` is `containsMany(FieldDef)`, while `FileDef extends BaseDef` (`packages/base/card-api.gts:3080`) is a **sibling** of both — so neither field accepts a file instance.

Fix: add `fileExamples = linksToMany(FileDef)` to Spec, surfaced when the spec kind is a file. `linksToMany(FileDef)` is already a supported primitive (`base/markdown-file-def.gts:390`, `base/rich-markdown.gts:111`). `specType` also needs a `file` value — it is a free StringField carrying card/field/app/component today. Until this lands the 22 file defs sit one check short of Gold with nothing their authors can do about it.
